name: Sales Yesterday
query:
WITH RECURSIVE d_list AS (
    SELECT DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%%Y-%%m-01') AS `date`
    UNION ALL
    SELECT DATE_ADD(date, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
    FROM d_list
    WHERE DATE_ADD(date, INTERVAL 1 DAY) < CURDATE()
),
date_list AS (
    SELECT DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY) AS `date`
),
pax_data AS (
    SELECT
        date_list.`date` AS `date`,
        ROUND(SUM(CASE
            WHEN a.`order_type` = "Dine In" THEN ABS(a.`no_of_pax`)
            ELSE 0
        END), 2) AS `no_of_pax`,
        ROUND(SUM(a.`grand_total`),2) AS `grand_total`,
        ROUND((SUM(a.`grand_total`)/count(a.`name`)),2) AS `abv`,
        COUNT(a.`name`) AS `abs`
    FROM date_list
    LEFT JOIN `tabPOS Invoice` a ON (
        a.branch = %(branch)s
        AND a.`status` IN ("Consolidated", "Paid")
        AND a.`docstatus` = 1
    )
    LEFT JOIN `tabURY Report Settings` rs ON (
        rs.`branch` = %(branch)s
    )
    WHERE 
    (
        ((rs.`hours` IS NULL OR rs.`hours` = 0) AND a.`posting_date` = date_list.`date`)
        OR (rs.`hours` > 0 AND TIMESTAMP(a.`posting_date`, a.`posting_time`) <= TIMESTAMP(DATE_ADD(date_list.`date`, INTERVAL 1 DAY), CONCAT(LPAD(rs.`hours`, 2, '0'), ':00:00')) AND TIMESTAMP(a.`posting_date`, a.`posting_time`) >= TIMESTAMP(date_list.`date`, CONCAT(LPAD(rs.`hours`, 2, '0'), ':00:00')))
        OR (rs.`branch` IS NULL AND a.`posting_date` = date_list.`date`)
    )
    GROUP BY date_list.`date`
),
item_data AS (
    SELECT
        date_list.`date` AS `date`,
        ROUND(SUM(CASE
            WHEN a.`order_type` = "Dine In" THEN b.`qty`
            ELSE 0
        END), 2) AS `total_dish`
    FROM date_list
    LEFT JOIN `tabPOS Invoice` a ON (
        a.branch = %(branch)s
        AND a.`status` IN ("Consolidated", "Paid")
        AND a.`docstatus` = 1
    )
    LEFT JOIN `tabURY Report Settings` rs ON (
        rs.`branch` = %(branch)s
    )
    INNER JOIN `tabPOS Invoice Item` b ON a.`name` = b.`parent`
    WHERE 
        (
            ((rs.`hours` IS NULL OR rs.`hours` = 0) AND a.`posting_date` = date_list.`date`)
            OR (rs.`hours` > 0 AND TIMESTAMP(a.`posting_date`, a.`posting_time`) <= TIMESTAMP(DATE_ADD(date_list.`date`, INTERVAL 1 DAY), CONCAT(LPAD(rs.`hours`, 2, '0'), ':00:00')) AND TIMESTAMP(a.`posting_date`, a.`posting_time`) >= TIMESTAMP(date_list.`date`, CONCAT(LPAD(rs.`hours`, 2, '0'), ':00:00')))
            OR (rs.`branch` IS NULL AND a.`posting_date` = date_list.`date`)
        )
        AND b.`is_disposable` = 0
    GROUP BY date_list.`date`
),
monthly_avg_sales_data AS (
    SELECT
        ROUND(SUM(b.grand_total) / COUNT(DISTINCT d_list.`date`), 2) AS `monthly_avg_sales`
    FROM d_list 
    LEFT JOIN `tabPOS Invoice` b ON (
        b.`branch` = %(branch)s
        AND b.`status` IN ("Consolidated","Paid") 
        AND b.`docstatus` = 1 
    )
    LEFT JOIN `tabURY Report Settings` rs ON (
        rs.`branch` = %(branch)s
    )
    WHERE
    (
        ((rs.`hours` IS NULL OR rs.`hours` = 0) AND b.`posting_date` = d_list.`date`)
        OR (rs.`hours` > 0 AND TIMESTAMP(b.`posting_date`, b.`posting_time`) <= TIMESTAMP(DATE_ADD(d_list.`date`, INTERVAL 1 DAY), CONCAT(LPAD(rs.`hours`, 2, '0'), ':00:00')) AND TIMESTAMP(b.`posting_date`, b.`posting_time`) >= TIMESTAMP(d_list.`date`, CONCAT(LPAD(rs.`hours`, 2, '0'), ':00:00')))
        OR (rs.`branch` IS NULL AND b.`posting_date` = d_list.`date`)
    )
),
combined_data AS (
    SELECT
        d.`date`,
        COALESCE(p.`abv`, 0) AS `abv`,
        (SELECT `monthly_avg_sales` FROM monthly_avg_sales_data) AS `monthly_avg_sales`,
        COALESCE(p.`grand_total`, 0) AS `grand_total`,
        COALESCE(p.`no_of_pax`, 0) AS `no_of_pax`,
        COALESCE(i.`total_dish`, 0) AS `total_dish`,
        COALESCE(p.`abs`, 0) AS `abs`
    FROM date_list d
    LEFT JOIN pax_data p ON d.`date` = p.`date`
    LEFT JOIN item_data i ON d.`date` = i.`date`
)
SELECT
    cd.`date` AS "Date:Date:100",
    cd.`grand_total` AS "Sales:Currency:100",
    ROUND((cd.`no_of_pax` / cd.`total_dish`), 3) AS "Average Per Cover:Float:100",
    cd.`abv` AS "Average Bill Value:Currency:100",
    cd.`abs` AS "Average Bill Size:Int:100",
    cd.`monthly_avg_sales` AS "Monthly Average Sales:Currency:100"
FROM combined_data cd
ORDER BY cd.`date` DESC;
